items.question: Trong câu "AWS offers several storage options, each optimized for a specific situation.", từ "several" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS offers several storage options, each optimized for a specific situation.", what does "several" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: more than two but not many
items.explanation: several /ˈsev.ɚ.əl/ (tính từ): một vài, nhiều (hơn hai). "Several storage options" = nhiều lựa chọn lưu trữ khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: several /ˈsev.ɚ.əl/ (adjective): more than two but not many. "Several storage options" means a number of different storage choices.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS offers several storage options, each optimized for a specific situation.", từ "situation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS offers several storage options, each optimized for a specific situation.", what does "situation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: situation /ˌsɪtʃ.uˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): tình huống, hoàn cảnh. "A specific situation" = một tình huống cụ thể mà mỗi loại lưu trữ phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: situation /ˌsɪtʃ.uˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a set of circumstances. "A specific situation" is a particular case that each storage type is suited to.

items.question: Trong câu "EBS: a network drive attached to EC2; data is persistent.", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EBS: a network drive attached to EC2; data is persistent.", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
options: bền vững, được giữ lại lâu dài
items.explanation: persistent /pɚˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): bền vững, được giữ lại lâu dài. Dữ liệu persistent vẫn còn khi instance dừng. Danh từ: persistence.
items.explanationEn: persistent /pɚˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): lasting; kept even after stopping. Persistent data survives when the instance stops. Noun: persistence.

items.question: Trong câu "EC2 Instance Store: a physical disk attached directly to the host machine — extremely fast but ephemeral.", từ "host" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EC2 Instance Store: a physical disk attached directly to the host machine — extremely fast but ephemeral.", what does "host" (noun) mean?
options: máy chủ vật lý chạy các máy ảo
optionsEn: the physical machine that runs virtual machines
items.explanation: host /hoʊst/ (danh từ): máy chủ vật lý chạy các máy ảo. "Host machine" = máy vật lý nơi instance EC2 đang chạy.
items.explanationEn: host /hoʊst/ (noun): the physical machine that runs virtual machines. The "host machine" is the physical server on which the EC2 instance runs.

items.question: Trong câu "a physical disk attached directly to the host machine — extremely fast but ephemeral.", từ "ephemeral" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a physical disk attached directly to the host machine — extremely fast but ephemeral.", what does "ephemeral" (adjective) mean?
options: tạm thời, chỉ tồn tại trong thời gian ngắn
items.explanation: ephemeral /ɪˈfem.ɚ.əl/ (tính từ): tạm thời, chỉ tồn tại trong thời gian ngắn. Instance Store là ephemeral: dữ liệu mất khi instance dừng. Trái nghĩa: persistent.
items.explanationEn: ephemeral /ɪˈfem.ɚ.əl/ (adjective): lasting only a short time. Instance Store is ephemeral: data is lost when the instance stops. Opposite: persistent.

items.question: Trong câu "The focus is on choosing the right storage type based on requirements.", từ "focus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The focus is on choosing the right storage type based on requirements.", what does "focus" (noun) mean?
options: trọng tâm, điểm tập trung chính
items.explanation: focus /ˈfoʊ.kəs/ (danh từ): trọng tâm, điểm tập trung chính. "The focus is on..." = trọng tâm là... Cũng dùng như động từ: focus on.
items.explanationEn: focus /ˈfoʊ.kəs/ (noun): the main point of attention. "The focus is on..." means the main attention is on... Also a verb: focus on.

items.question: Trong câu "The focus is on choosing the right storage type based on requirements.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The focus is on choosing the right storage type based on requirements.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
options: yêu cầu, điều kiện cần có
optionsEn: something that is needed or demanded
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪr.mənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu, điều kiện cần có. "Based on requirements" = dựa trên các yêu cầu (một instance hay nhiều, một AZ hay nhiều...). Động từ: require.
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪr.mənt/ (noun): something that is needed or demanded. "Based on requirements" means according to what is needed (one instance or many, single-AZ or multi-AZ...). Verb: require.

items.question: Trong câu "there is a small latency, but in exchange it can be detached from one instance and attached to another very quickly.", từ "in exchange" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "there is a small latency, but in exchange it can be detached from one instance and attached to another very quickly.", what does "in exchange" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: as something given back in return
items.explanation: in exchange /ɪn ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (cụm từ): đổi lại, bù lại. EBS có độ trễ nhỏ, nhưng đổi lại có thể tháo ra gắn sang instance khác nhanh.
items.explanationEn: in exchange /ɪn ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (phrase): as something given back in return. EBS has a little latency, but in return it can be moved between instances quickly.

items.question: Trong câu "in exchange it can be detached from one instance and attached to another very quickly.", từ "detached" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "in exchange it can be detached from one instance and attached to another very quickly.", what does "detached" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to remove or separate from something
items.explanation: detach /dɪˈtætʃ/ (động từ): tháo ra, tách rời. Volume được detached (tháo) khỏi instance này rồi attached (gắn) vào instance khác. Trái nghĩa: attach.
items.explanationEn: detach /dɪˈtætʃ/ (verb): to remove or separate from something. The volume is detached from one instance and attached to another. Opposite: attach.

items.question: Trong câu "A volume created in us-east-1a cannot be directly attached to an instance in us-east-1b.", từ "volume" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A volume created in us-east-1a cannot be directly attached to an instance in us-east-1b.", what does "volume" (noun) mean?
options: ổ đĩa lưu trữ (khối lưu trữ)
items.explanation: volume /ˈvɑːl.juːm/ (danh từ): ổ đĩa lưu trữ (khối lưu trữ). Trong AWS, EBS volume là một ổ đĩa ảo gắn vào instance, không phải "âm lượng".
items.explanationEn: volume /ˈvɑːl.juːm/ (noun): a unit of disk storage. In AWS, an EBS volume is a virtual disk attached to an instance, not sound loudness.

items.question: Trong câu "By default, a volume can only attach to one instance at a time (except for the Multi-Attach feature of io1/io2).", từ "feature" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "By default, a volume can only attach to one instance at a time (except for the Multi-Attach feature of io1/io2).", what does "feature" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a function or capability of a product
items.explanation: feature /ˈfiː.tʃɚ/ (danh từ): tính năng. "The Multi-Attach feature" = tính năng Multi-Attach.
items.explanationEn: feature /ˈfiː.tʃɚ/ (noun): a function or capability of a product. "The Multi-Attach feature" is the Multi-Attach capability.

items.question: Trong câu "when you stop or terminate an instance, the volume can be kept (depending on the setting).", từ "terminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when you stop or terminate an instance, the volume can be kept (depending on the setting).", what does "terminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: terminate /ˈtɝː.mə.neɪt/ (động từ): chấm dứt, xóa hẳn (instance). Terminate instance = xóa hẳn instance, khác với stop (tạm dừng). Danh từ: termination.
items.explanationEn: terminate /ˈtɝː.mə.neɪt/ (verb): to end permanently; delete (an instance). Terminating an instance deletes it permanently, unlike stopping it. Noun: termination.

items.question: Trong câu "when you stop or terminate an instance, the volume can be kept (depending on the setting).", từ "depending" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when you stop or terminate an instance, the volume can be kept (depending on the setting).", what does "depending" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depending on /dɪˈpen.dɪŋ ɑːn/ (cụm từ): tùy thuộc vào. Volume có được giữ hay không tùy thuộc vào thiết lập DeleteOnTermination.
items.explanationEn: depending on /dɪˈpen.dɪŋ ɑːn/ (phrase): according to; decided by. Whether the volume is kept is decided by the DeleteOnTermination setting.

items.question: Trong câu "To move a volume to another AZ → create a snapshot, then restore the snapshot into the new AZ.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To move a volume to another AZ → create a snapshot, then restore the snapshot into the new AZ.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
options: bản chụp dữ liệu tại một thời điểm
optionsEn: a copy of data at a point in time
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɑːt/ (danh từ): bản chụp dữ liệu tại một thời điểm. Snapshot của EBS là bản sao lưu volume tại một thời điểm.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɑːt/ (noun): a copy of data at a point in time. An EBS snapshot is a point-in-time backup of a volume.

items.question: Trong câu "To move a volume to another AZ → create a snapshot, then restore the snapshot into the new AZ.", từ "restore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To move a volume to another AZ → create a snapshot, then restore the snapshot into the new AZ.", what does "restore" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring back to a previous state
items.explanation: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (động từ): khôi phục. Restore the snapshot = khôi phục snapshot thành volume mới. Danh từ: restoration.
items.explanationEn: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (verb): to bring back to a previous state. To restore a snapshot is to turn it back into a working volume. Noun: restoration.

items.question: Trong câu "You can resize and change the volume type while it is running.", từ "resize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can resize and change the volume type while it is running.", what does "resize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resize /ˌriːˈsaɪz/ (động từ): thay đổi kích thước. Có thể resize volume EBS (tăng dung lượng) khi nó đang chạy.
items.explanationEn: resize /ˌriːˈsaɪz/ (verb): to change the size of. You can resize an EBS volume (make it bigger) while it is running.

items.question: Trong câu "SSD (optimized for IOPS – I/O operations per second) and HDD (optimized for throughput – MB/s).", từ "operations" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SSD (optimized for IOPS – I/O operations per second) and HDD (optimized for throughput – MB/s).", what does "operations" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a single action performed by a system
items.explanation: operation /ˌɑː.pəˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): thao tác, lần xử lý. IOPS = số thao tác đọc/ghi mỗi giây.
items.explanationEn: operation /ˌɑː.pəˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a single action performed by a system. IOPS counts input/output operations (reads/writes) per second.

items.question: Trong câu "gp3: provision IOPS & throughput independently of size.", từ "independently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gp3: provision IOPS & throughput independently of size.", what does "independently" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách độc lập, không phụ thuộc
optionsEn: without being affected by something else
items.explanation: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách độc lập, không phụ thuộc. "Independently of size" = không phụ thuộc vào dung lượng volume.
items.explanationEn: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (adverb): without being affected by something else. "Independently of size" means not linked to the volume size.

items.question: Trong câu "gp2: Older; IOPS is tied to volume size.", từ "tied" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gp2: Older; IOPS is tied to volume size.", what does "tied" (phrase) mean?
options: gắn liền với, phụ thuộc vào
items.explanation: tied to /taɪd tuː/ (cụm từ): gắn liền với, phụ thuộc vào. Với gp2, IOPS gắn liền với dung lượng: muốn IOPS cao phải mua volume lớn hơn.
items.explanationEn: tied to /taɪd tuː/ (phrase): closely linked to; dependent on. With gp2, IOPS is linked to size: more IOPS means a bigger volume.

items.question: Trong câu "gp2: Same as gp3 (usually worth upgrading to gp3).", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gp2: Same as gp3 (usually worth upgrading to gp3).", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɝːθ/ (tính từ): đáng (làm gì). "Worth upgrading" = đáng để nâng cấp. Cấu trúc: worth + V-ing.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɝːθ/ (adjective): deserving to be done; beneficial. "Worth upgrading" means the upgrade is beneficial. Pattern: worth + -ing.

items.question: Trong câu "gp2: Same as gp3 (usually worth upgrading to gp3).", từ "upgrading" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gp2: Same as gp3 (usually worth upgrading to gp3).", what does "upgrading" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change to a newer or better version
items.explanation: upgrade /ʌpˈɡreɪd/ (động từ): nâng cấp. Upgrading to gp3 = chuyển lên loại volume mới hơn, tốt hơn.
items.explanationEn: upgrade /ʌpˈɡreɪd/ (verb): to change to a newer or better version. Upgrading to gp3 means moving to the newer, better volume type.

items.question: Trong câu "io2/io1: Highest performance, very high IOPS, supports Multi-Attach.", từ "performance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "io2/io1: Highest performance, very high IOPS, supports Multi-Attach.", what does "performance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how fast and well a system works
items.explanation: performance /pɚˈfɔːr.məns/ (danh từ): hiệu năng. Trong IT, performance = hiệu năng (tốc độ, IOPS, độ trễ).
items.explanationEn: performance /pɚˈfɔːr.məns/ (noun): how fast and well a system works. In IT, performance means speed and efficiency (IOPS, latency).

items.question: Trong câu "io2/io1: Mission-critical databases, high-I/O, low-latency apps.", từ "mission-critical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "io2/io1: Mission-critical databases, high-I/O, low-latency apps.", what does "mission-critical" (adjective) mean?
options: cực kỳ quan trọng, không được phép hỏng
optionsEn: essential; failure would cause serious harm
items.explanation: mission-critical /ˈmɪʃ.ən ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): cực kỳ quan trọng, không được phép hỏng. Mission-critical databases = cơ sở dữ liệu sống còn với hoạt động doanh nghiệp.
items.explanationEn: mission-critical /ˈmɪʃ.ən ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): essential; failure would cause serious harm. Mission-critical databases are vital to the business and must not fail.

items.question: Trong câu "st1: Big data, data warehouses, log processing, streaming.", từ "streaming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "st1: Big data, data warehouses, log processing, streaming.", what does "streaming" (noun) mean?
options: truyền phát dữ liệu liên tục
optionsEn: sending data continuously as a flow
items.explanation: streaming /ˈstriː.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): truyền phát dữ liệu liên tục. Streaming cần throughput cao nên hợp với st1. Động từ: stream.
items.explanationEn: streaming /ˈstriː.mɪŋ/ (noun): sending data continuously as a flow. Streaming needs high throughput, so it suits st1. Verb: stream.

items.question: Trong câu "sc1: Infrequently accessed data, low-cost storage.", từ "low-cost" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sc1: Infrequently accessed data, low-cost storage.", what does "low-cost" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: low-cost /ˌloʊˈkɑːst/ (tính từ): chi phí thấp, giá rẻ. Low-cost storage = lưu trữ giá rẻ, phù hợp dữ liệu ít truy cập.
items.explanationEn: low-cost /ˌloʊˈkɑːst/ (adjective): cheap; not expensive. Low-cost storage is cheap storage for rarely accessed data.

items.question: Trong câu "The key distinction of gp3: you can raise IOPS and throughput without increasing size.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key distinction of gp3: you can raise IOPS and throughput without increasing size.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): điểm khác biệt. "Key distinction" = điểm khác biệt chính. Động từ: distinguish.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a difference between similar things. "Key distinction" is the main difference. Verb: distinguish.

items.question: Trong câu "you can raise IOPS (up to 16,000) and throughput (up to 1,000 MB/s) without increasing size.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you can raise IOPS (up to 16,000) and throughput (up to 1,000 MB/s) without increasing size.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): tăng lên, nâng lên. Raise IOPS = tăng IOPS. Khác với rise (tự tăng, nội động từ).
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to increase. To raise IOPS is to increase it. Compare rise (intransitive).

items.question: Trong câu "With the older gp2, getting more IOPS forces you to buy a larger volume.", từ "forces" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With the older gp2, getting more IOPS forces you to buy a larger volume.", what does "forces" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːrs/ (động từ): buộc, ép phải. "Forces you to buy" = buộc bạn phải mua. Cấu trúc: force sb to do sth.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːrs/ (verb): to make someone do something. "Forces you to buy" means you have no choice but to buy. Pattern: force sb to do sth.

items.question: Trong câu "gp3: General workloads, web servers, dev/test environments.", từ "workloads" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "gp3: General workloads, web servers, dev/test environments.", what does "workloads" (noun) mean?
options: khối lượng công việc/ứng dụng chạy trên hệ thống
optionsEn: the applications and tasks a system runs
items.explanation: workload /ˈwɝːk.loʊd/ (danh từ): khối lượng công việc/ứng dụng chạy trên hệ thống. "General workloads" = các ứng dụng/tác vụ thông thường.
items.explanationEn: workload /ˈwɝːk.loʊd/ (noun): the applications and tasks a system runs. "General workloads" are ordinary applications and tasks.

items.question: Trong câu "A snapshot is a backup of a volume at a point in time.", từ "backup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A snapshot is a backup of a volume at a point in time.", what does "backup" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a copy kept in case the original is lost
items.explanation: backup /ˈbæk.ʌp/ (danh từ): bản sao lưu. Snapshot là bản sao lưu volume. Động từ: back up.
items.explanationEn: backup /ˈbæk.ʌp/ (noun): a copy kept in case the original is lost. A snapshot is a backup copy of a volume. Verb: back up.

items.question: Trong câu "Snapshots are incremental: they only store the blocks changed since the previous snapshot.", từ "incremental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Snapshots are incremental: they only store the blocks changed since the previous snapshot.", what does "incremental" (adjective) mean?
options: gia tăng, chỉ lưu phần thay đổi
optionsEn: adding only what changed since last time
items.explanation: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.t̬əl/ (tính từ): gia tăng, chỉ lưu phần thay đổi. Snapshot incremental chỉ lưu các block thay đổi so với lần trước → tiết kiệm chi phí.
items.explanationEn: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.t̬əl/ (adjective): adding only what changed since last time. Incremental snapshots store only the blocks changed since the last one, saving cost.

items.question: Trong câu "You can copy a snapshot to another region → this is the primary way to move EBS across AZs and regions.", từ "primary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can copy a snapshot to another region → this is the primary way to move EBS across AZs and regions.", what does "primary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: primary /ˈpraɪ.mer.i/ (tính từ): chính, chủ yếu. "The primary way" = cách chính. Trạng từ: primarily.
items.explanationEn: primary /ˈpraɪ.mer.i/ (adjective): main; most important. "The primary way" is the main way. Adverb: primarily.

items.question: Trong câu "EBS Snapshot Archive moves a snapshot to an archive storage tier that is ~75% cheaper.", từ "archive" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EBS Snapshot Archive moves a snapshot to an archive storage tier that is ~75% cheaper.", what does "archive" (noun) mean?
options: kho lưu trữ lâu dài (ít truy cập)
optionsEn: long-term storage for rarely used data
items.explanation: archive /ˈɑːr.kaɪv/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ lâu dài (ít truy cập). Archive tier = tầng lưu trữ lâu dài, rẻ nhưng khôi phục chậm (24–72 giờ).
items.explanationEn: archive /ˈɑːr.kaɪv/ (noun): long-term storage for rarely used data. The archive tier is cheap long-term storage, but restoring is slow (24–72 hours).

items.explanationEn: tier /tɪr/ (noun): a level or class in a system. A storage tier is a level of storage with its own price and speed.

items.explanationEn: retention /rɪˈten.ʃən/ (noun): keeping something for a period of time. Retention rules define how long deleted snapshots are kept. Verb: retain.

items.explanationEn: recover /rɪˈkʌv.ɚ/ (verb): to get back to a normal state; get back. "Recover from accidental deletion" means getting data back after deleting it by mistake. Noun: recovery.

items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): an effect on something. "No latency impact" means latency is almost unaffected.

items.explanationEn: responsible /rɪˈspɑːn.sə.bəl/ (adjective): having the duty to do something. "Responsible for backing up" means backups are your duty. Noun: responsibility.

items.explanationEn: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (noun): a short reference to something. Mention is also a verb: to mention something.

items.question: Trong câu "FSx for Lustre: for HPC, machine learning, and large-scale data processing.", từ "large-scale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "FSx for Lustre: for HPC, machine learning, and large-scale data processing.", what does "large-scale" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: very big in size or scope
items.explanation: large-scale /ˌlɑːrdʒˈskeɪl/ (tính từ): quy mô lớn. Large-scale data processing = xử lý dữ liệu quy mô lớn.
items.explanationEn: large-scale /ˌlɑːrdʒˈskeɪl/ (adjective): very big in size or scope. Large-scale data processing handles huge amounts of data.

items.question: Trong câu "Snapshots: incremental, can be copied cross-region/cross-AZ; there is an Archive tier (cheap).", từ "cheap" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Snapshots: incremental, can be copied cross-region/cross-AZ; there is an Archive tier (cheap).", what does "cheap" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cheap /tʃiːp/ (tính từ): rẻ. Archive tier (cheap) = tầng lưu trữ giá rẻ. So sánh hơn: cheaper.
items.explanationEn: cheap /tʃiːp/ (adjective): low in price. The Archive tier is low-priced. Comparative: cheaper.

items.question: Trong câu "there is an Archive tier (cheap) and a Recycle Bin (accidental-deletion protection).", từ "protection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "there is an Archive tier (cheap) and a Recycle Bin (accidental-deletion protection).", what does "protection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: protection /prəˈtek.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự bảo vệ. Accidental-deletion protection = bảo vệ khỏi xóa nhầm. Động từ: protect.
items.explanationEn: protection /prəˈtek.ʃən/ (noun): keeping something safe from harm. Accidental-deletion protection guards against deleting by mistake. Verb: protect.

items.question: Trong câu "AMI is region-scoped and can be copied to another region.", từ "region-scoped" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AMI is region-scoped and can be copied to another region.", what does "region-scoped" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: region-scoped /ˈriː.dʒən skoʊpt/ (tính từ): giới hạn trong một region. Region-scoped = phạm vi chỉ trong một region; muốn dùng nơi khác phải copy.
items.explanationEn: region-scoped /ˈriː.dʒən skoʊpt/ (adjective): limited to one region. Region-scoped means limited to one region; copy it to use elsewhere.

items.question: Trong câu "AMI is used to pre-bake instances for faster boot.", từ "pre-bake" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AMI is used to pre-bake instances for faster boot.", what does "pre-bake" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to prepare in advance with everything installed
items.explanation: pre-bake /ˌpriːˈbeɪk/ (động từ): chuẩn bị/cài sẵn từ trước. Pre-bake = cài sẵn phần mềm vào AMI để instance khởi động nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: pre-bake /ˌpriːˈbeɪk/ (verb): to prepare in advance with everything installed. To pre-bake is to install software into the AMI so instances boot faster.

items.question: Trong câu "EBS = a persistent network drive, locked to one AZ.", từ "locked to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EBS = a persistent network drive, locked to one AZ.", what does "locked to" (phrase) mean?
options: bị cố định vào, chỉ dùng được ở
items.explanation: locked to /lɑːkt tuː/ (cụm từ): bị cố định vào, chỉ dùng được ở. EBS locked to one AZ = EBS chỉ dùng trong một AZ.
items.explanationEn: locked to /lɑːkt tuː/ (phrase): fixed to; cannot move from. EBS locked to one AZ can only be used in that AZ.

items.question: Trong câu "Volume types: gp3/gp2 (general-purpose SSD), io1/io2 (Provisioned IOPS, databases).", từ "general-purpose" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Volume types: gp3/gp2 (general-purpose SSD), io1/io2 (Provisioned IOPS, databases).", what does "general-purpose" (adjective) mean?
options: đa dụng, dùng cho mục đích chung
items.explanation: general-purpose /ˌdʒen.ɚ.əl ˈpɝː.pəs/ (tính từ): đa dụng, dùng cho mục đích chung. General-purpose SSD = SSD dùng cho hầu hết workload thông thường.
items.explanationEn: general-purpose /ˌdʒen.ɚ.əl ˈpɝː.pəs/ (adjective): suitable for many common uses. General-purpose SSD suits most ordinary workloads.

items.question: Trong câu "Summary", từ "summary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Summary", what does "summary" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a short statement of the main points
items.explanation: summary /ˈsʌm.ɚ.i/ (danh từ): bản tóm tắt. Summary = phần tóm tắt các ý chính. Động từ: summarize.
items.explanationEn: summary /ˈsʌm.ɚ.i/ (noun): a short statement of the main points. A summary gives the main points briefly. Verb: summarize.
